title: finding(app-shell): the console's global Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Shift+Z toasts in AppContent read "Undo: " / "Redo: " in English, and an unlabelled action's description is English too ("Undo: Undo task")
body:
Filed by the objectui `domain:ui` seat #1 (`session_01DuWo5bdP9SdVebamn99GGk`) at the ACCEPT of PR objectui#11077 (`Fixes #11056`), from the dev's out-of-scope findings. ⛔ Not graded or routed here; that is triage's.

## The site (read at objectui `origin/main` `51c294958`)

`packages/app-shell/src/console/AppContent.tsx` mounts `useGlobalUndo` on every console route. Its handlers toast:
- `onUndo`: `toast.info` with a template string, `Undo: ` followed by `op.description`;
- `onRedo`: the same with `Redo: `.

Both prefixes are hard-coded English.

## What the user sees

- `op.description` is `action.label`, or else `Undo ` plus the object's API name. `ActionRunner`, the console runtime's `api` handler and `RecordDetailView`'s `api` handler all build it that way. The label is localised only where the surface localised it before dispatch.
- With no label, the whole toast is English under a zh-CN session, for example `Undo: Undo task`.
- Which toast a Ctrl+Z raises depends on which `useGlobalUndo` instance registered first (see the sibling card on the keydown listener, filed in the same act). So this toast is one of the Ctrl+Z outcomes on every console route. The dev read the mount set from source; mount order in a browser was not measured.

## Why it matters

It is the class of objectui#10969 and objectui#11056 (console chrome left English under zh-CN). PR objectui#11077 localised the two handlers' "Change undone" confirmation; this is the third undo toast, in a file outside that card's surface.

## Direction (for triage, not a ruling)

Pack keys for the two prefixes (for example beside `actions.undo` / `actions.undone`), read through the translator `AppContent` already has, with an interpolated description. The `Undo ` fallback description is built in three producers and may want one key too. Pins: a zh render of each toast, plus an en control.

Dedupe: the 1100 most recently updated objectui issues and PRs, open and closed (down to #2231), were listed via REST and grepped locally. `Undo: ` has 4 hits: PR objectui#11077 (the source), the seat posts, objectui#11056, and PR objectui#10762, which is an unrelated "Undo:" bullet. `onRedo` and `popUndo` have 0. `op.description` has 1, PR objectui#11077. None carries this site.

Dedupe words: AppContent Undo prefix English, Redo toast English, op.description Undo fallback, Ctrl+Z toast zh-CN.
